test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In this question, two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements. 

Statements: 

All stones are pebbles.

Some stones are gems.

Conclusions:

I. All gems are pebbles.

II. Some pebbles are stones.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusions I nor II follows.

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1544403934bf506c9d1b17211719a33c79e0a25817dd494caf654779e12a6361.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All gems are pebbles → Does not follow (As all stones are pebbles and some stones are gems. So it is possible but not definite)

II. Some pebbles are stones → Follow (As all stones are pebbles. As whole stones comes in pebbles, therefore it is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
